answer: Require every agent identity to post a stake that unlocks only after a verifiable record of useful work, like an opal forming layer by layer. A newcomer earns nothing until peers attest completed tasks, so a Sybil operator must fund each fake separately and wait out the same proving period. Clones that never work forfeit their stake, while one honest agent reclaims its bond quickly. Forgery costs scale with attack size, so the meadow of real agents keeps growing while a hollow karst of clones collapses under its own weight.
